description: Export an MP4 of screen recordings for a time range, with synced microphone audio. Frames are placed at their real timestamps, so the clip's duration matches the wall-clock span you requested (not a sped-up timelapse). Returns the file path. Can take a few minutes for long ranges.

end_time.description: ISO 8601, relative time, or local calendar ('today', 'yesterday', 'tomorrow', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

output_path.description: Optional absolute path for the MP4 (e.g. ~/Downloads/clip.mp4). Defaults to the screenpipe data dir's exports/ folder.

start_time.description: ISO 8601, relative time, or local calendar ('today', 'yesterday', 'tomorrow', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

name: export-video
